app.name: Vertrix2
app.long_description: Vertrix 2 on the Wii. Needs the original Vertrix2.vf in sd:/apps/vertrix2/. Plays with a Wii Remote (pointer and buttons), Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube pad, or a USB keyboard and mouse. HOME exits. Checks github.com/quatric/Vertrix2 for new releases at startup.
